meta.title: Taskboard · UI
meta.description:
Every taskboard entry point in the browser. The same panel opens in three places, independently:

(1) A left sidebar icon — opens the panel across the main area.
(2) A drawer beside the composer — rises from the composer edge without leaving the conversation.
(3) A tab in the right workspace — sits beside files, terminals and the like.

All three read the same data through the same components but keep their own selection state: switching workspace in one does not disturb what another is showing.

It only draws and clicks: rendering sections, pressing status buttons, editing notes, creating cards, dragging splitters. It does not decide states, judge whether a transition is allowed, or touch the disk. A wrong rule is fixed in core, not here.

Switch it off and the plugin keeps running, agents keep their tools and the data stays — but no entry point is visible to a human. The three entry points have no individual switches yet; turning this package off removes all three.
